person_note: The novel has sustained narration in two persons. Brian Andrews, initially unidentified, narrates the prologue and recurring interludes as a participating first-person storyteller; q00927 belongs to this constitutive strand rather than to dialogue or an embedded document. The majority narrative presents Miles, Sarah, and others in sustained third person, corroborated by q00925, q00929, and q00936–q00938. Dialogue and gnomic uses of I, we, or you were treated as nondiagnostic. The authorized opening directly demonstrates the first-to-third transition, and multiple whole-book descriptions confirm that first-person chapters are intercalated with the third-person majority. No credible contrary evidence remains.
